product_metadata.title: XBelmber Acrylic Ziplock Bag Organizer, Ziplock Bag Storage Container Holder for Drawer, Compatible with Ziploc Bags in Gallon, Sandwich, Snack & Variety Size - Clear
features: COMPATIBLE WITH MOST BAG BRANDS - The ziplock bag organizer contains 4 compartments for variety ziplock bags like sandwich, quart, snack and gallon bags, compatible with Ziploc, Solimo, Hefty, Glad, Great Value and other brands. It also fit for storage and freezer and quart size slider bags. There are 4 laser engraved logos on the bag container, which are convenient for you to take the bag you want.

Your Premium Drawer Organizer - In a crystal glass clear look, this baggie organizer bring a stylish flair to your home. It keeps the ziplock food bags organized and separated, allowing for more useable space, fits perfectly in your kitchen drawer and cleans it up nicely.

No Assemble & Easy to Use - Come fully assembled one-piece acrylic storage bag organizer box. The strong magnetic attraction will close the lid firmly, and don't worry about the top coming off when you pull a baggie out. Anti-skid pad is added at the bottom.
Premium Quality Material - This food bag storage organizer is made of safe and waterproof premium acrylic, easy to clean and maintain. It's sturdy, well made and well protected and packaged.

WIDE APPLICABILITY - The ziplock bag storage organizer has a perfect size of 7.9x 5.8x 3.0 inches (L×W×H). Clean lines and modern look can match any kitchen. You can easily put it on the kitchen counter, drawer, cabinet. There are 4 holes on the back of the zip lock storage bags holder, and you can also hang it on the wall. Installation screws are provided in the package.
